description: List connected CMS targets (WordPress, Ghost, Sanity) and their connectionIds. Use before syncpen_publish to find the connectionId when a target has more than one active connection. Connectors are personal by default; pass teamId to see a specific team's connectors directly (use syncpen_list_teams to find its id), or documentId to see an existing document's own space's connectors — each space can have different ones.

documentId.description: Scope the list to this document's space (its team, or personal) instead of personal connectors.

teamId.description: Scope the list directly to this team's connectors. Takes precedence over documentId if both are given.

name: syncpen_list_connections
